known_text: I had a glass or two of water.

use.known: I went to the office this morning to meet my friends.
use.target: 我今天早上去办公室见我朋友了。

use.known: She asked if I want to come with her this weekend.
use.target: 她问我是不是想这个周末和她一起来。

use.known: If I have time tomorrow, I will go out with my friends.
use.target: 如果我明天有时间，我会和我朋友出去。

use.known: I hope I can see a few of my friends before Saturday.
use.target: 我希望我星期六之前可以见几个朋友。

use.known: Everyone told me they want to spend time with me soon.
use.target: 大家都告诉我他们想快一点和我花时间。

use.known: Did anyone tell you I went out on Saturday night?
use.target: 有人告诉你我星期六晚上出去了吗？

use.known: I like to drink something when I am at the office.
use.target: 我喜欢在办公室的时候喝东西。

use.known: She said she wants to drink something with us tomorrow.
use.target: 她说她想明天和我们喝东西。

use.known: If you want to drink something, please let me know.
use.target: 如果你想喝东西，请让我知道。

use.known: I didn't drink anything when I was at the meeting yesterday.
use.target: 我昨天在开会的时候没有喝东西。

use.known: Everyone wants to drink something before we go out today.
use.target: 大家都想今天出去之前喝东西。

use.known: Did you drink something this morning before you came here?
use.target: 你今天早上来这里之前喝东西了吗？

use.known: I drank something and then went out with my friends.
use.target: 我喝了东西然后和我朋友出去了。

use.known: She told me she already had something to drink yesterday.
use.target: 她告诉我她昨天已经喝了东西了。

use.known: If you already drank something, you don't need more.
use.target: 如果你已经喝了东西，你不需要更多。

use.known: I already finished everything we talked about last time.
use.target: 我已经完成了我们上次说的一切。

use.known: Everyone said they already had something this morning.
use.target: 大家都说他们今天早上已经喝了东西了。

use.known: Did you know I drank something before I came to work?
use.target: 你知道我来工作之前喝了东西吗？

use.known: I drank one or two things before going out today.
use.target: 我今天出去之前喝了一两个东西。

use.known: She asked if we can meet one or two people at the office.
use.target: 她问我们是不是可以在办公室见一两个人。

use.known: If you have one or two minutes, I want to talk with you.
use.target: 如果你有一两分钟，我想和你说话。

use.known: I only want to have one or two things before we leave.
use.target: 我们走之前我只想喝一两个东西。

use.known: Everyone had one or two things to drink at the meeting.
use.target: 大家在开会的时候都喝了一两个东西。

use.known: Did you have one or two things before you came here?
use.target: 你来这里之前喝了一两个东西吗？

use.known: I had one or two glasses of something and felt better.
use.target: 我喝了一两杯东西，觉得好了一些。

use.known: She said she wants to have a glass of something with us.
use.target: 她说她想和我们喝一杯东西。

use.known: If you have a few glasses, you will feel much better.
use.target: 如果你喝几杯，你会觉得好很多。

use.known: I drank a few glasses before going to the meeting today.
use.target: 我今天去开会之前喝了几杯。

use.known: Everyone wants to have a glass before we start working.
use.target: 大家都想开始工作之前喝一杯。

use.known: Did you know I had several glasses this morning already?
use.target: 你知道我今天早上已经喝了几杯了吗？

use.known: I had a glass or two of water when I got to the office.
use.target: 我到办公室的时候喝了一两杯水。

use.known: She asked if we have any water at the office for everyone.
use.target: 她问我们办公室是不是有水给大家。

use.known: If you don't have water, I can give you some of mine.
use.target: 如果你没有水，我可以给你一些我的。

use.known: I like to drink water when I am working in the evening.
use.target: 我喜欢晚上工作的时候喝水。

use.known: Everyone needs to drink water when they are at work.
use.target: 大家工作的时候都需要喝水。

use.known: Did you bring any water with you when you came here?
use.target: 你来这里的时候带水了吗？
